name: Nova Mono
summary: Google Fonts specimen page for Nova Mono, the monospace member of the Nova family, with Greek and Latin coverage.
description: Specimen page for Nova Mono on Google Fonts. Its description traces the design to NovaCut, a typeface originally cut for stone inscriptions, later expanded into a seven-font Nova family (Cut, Flat, Oval, Round, Slim, Square and Mono). Single regular (400) weight; Greek, Latin and Latin Extended subsets; designed by Wojciech Kalinowski; category listed as Monospace.
contains: monospace member of the seven-font Nova family
Greek, Latin and Latin Extended subsets
